Evidence (findings, cited code, tests and checks) #### Claude C1 [major, correctness]: The issue's 3.1.1 regression is not on this base; the change fixes a different crash Issue #2234 says the analyzer stopped working for SuppressSourceGeneration = true in 3.1.1. The cause in history is commit 1a74a620 ('stop collect field when object marked SuppressSourceGeneration', in v3.1.1 and still in v3.1.12): it moved the 'if (suppressSourceGeneration is true) return null;' to right after the attribute is read, before any member is analyzed. Base 32258fdb is on the develop line and does not contain v3.1.0/v3.1.1 or that commit. Its early return is at line 1369, after member collection, which is why MsgPack004/003/015 tests already pass on base. So the agent fixed the duplicate/mixed-key crashes (which hit non-suppressed types too, see DuplicateKeysAreReportedWithoutAnalyzerFailureForGeneratedTypes failing on base) and wrote tests and README text as if that were #2234. Merged into the 3.1.x/master line, this change would not restore the analyzer for suppressed types; the early return would still need to move. For a positional record property it is a ParameterSyntax, so AD0001 InvalidCastException. Reproduced at this head with SuppressSourceGeneration = true (own probe). Acceptable because the type already has an error, but it hides a second problem until the first is fixed. Now it keeps the first member and emits a formatter without the second. The build still fails while MsgPack005 is an error, but if a project lowers that diagnostic's severity, it silently loses data. I saw this in my probe (formatter generated, analyzer reports MsgPack005).
